Finally, Senate Republicans are starting to listen to their constituents.

The American people do not want to spend billions on endless wars. They want to address the enormous crises facing our country.

We must end this unconstitutional war.


CBS News (@CBSNews)

BREAKING: Senate advances resolution to limit Trump's Iran war powers for first time, after four Republicans defect. cbsn.ws/4eWdk5N




— https://nitter.net/CBSNews/status/2056855477938516169#m
Pope Leo is right.

Three people were murdered in a hate-driven attack at a mosque in San Diego, including a security guard who died protecting others.

This country must not succumb to hatred. We must stand united against Islamophobia, antisemitism, racism and all forms of bigotry.

According to a recent New York Times poll, 57% of Americans oppose the U.S. providing more economic and military support to Israel, while just 37% support.

Congress should listen to the American people. No more blank checks for war criminals like Benjamin Netanyahu.
Big Money dominates every aspect of Washington. Unless we get rid of super PACs, it’s going to get even worse.

Surprise, surprise: After months of Trump claiming Iran’s military was “decimated,” U.S. intelligence now says Iran still has 70% of its missile stockpile and most of its launch capability.

Maybe we shouldn’t let Netanyahu, a liar and a war criminal, dictate U.S. foreign policy.


The New York Times (@nytimes)

Breaking News: U.S. intelligence reports show that Iran retains substantial missile capacity, despite President Trump’s claims otherwise. nyti.ms/4dm0Lhw




— https://nitter.net/nytimes

Vaping is a major health hazard for kids.

But if you're Big Tobacco, you can spend $10 million to elect Trump & he'll make it legal for you to sell flavored vapes that endanger the health of Americans.

If you're a 62-year-old couple whose premiums quadrupled? Tough luck.

In the richest country in the history of the world, it is simply outrageous that 1 in 5 children will go hungry this year.
 
It’s time to end child hunger and make school meals free and universal.
nytimes.com/2026/05/13/techn…

When Andreesen Horowitz, a Silicon Valley firm with $100 billion in assets, can spend over $115 million to buy politicians who oppose regulating AI & crypto, you know our campaign finance system is broken.
 
End Citizens United, ban Super PACs & get Big Money out of politics-NOW!

Huge surveillance corporations like Palantir can use AI to increasingly track and record every aspect of our lives.

We cannot allow a handful of tech billionaires to destroy what remains of personal privacy in America.

Video

Of course Trump, the narcissist in chief, doesn't think about the financial situation of Americans.
 
To Trump, it doesn't matter that the working class is struggling economically.
 
What matters to Trump is that his family got $4 billion richer since he was elected. That's it.


Acyn (@Acyn)

Trump on Iran War:

Reporter: What extent are Americans’ financial situation motivating you to make a deal?

Trump: Not even a little bit. I don't think about Americans’ financial situation

Video

NOW is the time to end status quo politics, which benefit the billionaire class at the expense of working people.

NOW is the time to demand fundamental changes in the way Congress does business.

NOW is the time to think big, not small.

When we stand together we CAN do it.

Video

This is what the craziness in the White House is about. Trump’s budget includes:
 
$1 billion for his White House ballroom.
$1 billion in cuts to the National Park Service.

We should be investing in the needs of the working class, not more of the President's vanity projects.

We’re paying $4.55 for a gallon of gas because Trump started a war with Iran based on a lie - just like the wars in Vietnam and Iraq.
 
If we want to bring gas prices down below $3 a gallon we must demand that Trump ends this disastrous, unconstitutional and unprovoked war NOW.

Good news: Trump, who never lies, said he cut drug prices by 400-600%.

Quick. Go to your pharmacy. Demand a 400, 500%, 600% reduction on your drug prices. Tell them Trump sent you.

If that doesn’t work, tell Trump to support the bill I introduced to cut drug prices in half.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

Trump: "We're getting drug prices down by 400, 500 percent. Or depending on the way you want to phrase the question, you could say 600 percent, and you could also say 80 percent, 70 percent, etc. I

Happy Mother’s Day to Jane and to all of the mothers around the world. 

Let us continue our push for a world where all mothers can raise their families without the threat of war, with economic stability and where their rights are protected.

Massive wealth inequality is a global crisis.

The world’s 3,000 billionaires got $2.5 trillion richer last year & now hold $18.3T.

The 12 richest people own more wealth than the bottom half of humanity.

Our goal: create a global economy that works for ALL, not just the few.

The Trump Administration says the war in Iran will cost $25 billion.

That’s a lie.

This war could cost over $1 trillion—thousands of dollars for every household in America.

Invest in housing, education, and health care—not illegal and unconstitutional wars.

END THIS WAR NOW.
We can’t afford to deal with housing, healthcare and childcare. But we always have money for war?
Why did Trump bring his billionaire friends with him to China?
Status quo politics is not good enough. We must transform the Democratic Party.
FULL SPEECH: Bernie Sanders in Minnesota: "They have the money, but we have the people"
FULL SPEECH: Bernie in Michigan: "Our job as progressives is to transform the Democratic Party"
We are not ready for what’s coming.
Adam Hamawy was a 9/11 first responder, a combat trauma surgeon in Iraq & a volunteer in Gaza.
Americans don’t want their taxpayer dollars funding genocide.
Billionaires should not be able to buy elections. Overturn Citizens United.
FULL SPEECH: Bernie discusses the existential threat of AI and endless war in Ohio

How do we end the embarrassment of being the only major country not to guarantee healthcare to all as a human right? The answer is not complicated. We must elect candidates who are determined to pass Medicare for All.
What the Democratic party can do TOMORROW to stand up to big money.

The U.S. can’t afford to deal with housing, healthcare and childcare. But somehow, we always have the money for yet another bloody war? It’s time to say NO to a government that invests in war over the needs of working people.

In the last 15 months, we have recruited over 8,500 Americans to run for office at every level of government.   Today, I am proud to endorse 61 progressives running for state and local office across America. They will fight for the kind of changes our country desperately needs.
